Last year's Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro sparked a sensation right after its launch, but reports suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will replace that colour with an all-new burgundy. Here's a preview compiled from the latest leaks.

iPhone 18 Pro Main New Colour Preview

Apple has always tended to use understated, restrained colours for its Pro-series iPhones. But with the iPhone 17 Pro, Apple dramatically changed its strategy, breaking away from the past practice of offering only black and white, and instead launching the eye-catching Cosmic Orange, which immediately generated an enormous response.

Reports say Apple plans to continue this same bold colour direction with the iPhone 18 Pro.

However, this time it is expected to no longer be orange, but will offer three (or possibly four) colour options:

  • Burgundy / Deep Cherry
  • Light Blue
  • Silver
  • Possibly also dark grey

It is still unclear whether a dark grey or black version will be offered this year, but for the remaining three colours, reports from various sources are largely consistent.

Among them, Deep Cherry / burgundy is expected to be Apple's key promotional colour this time.

Leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted on Weibo today, saying they had previously seen both light and dark versions of this colour online. However, they believe the correct tone should be the dark version — a purple-tinged red, similar to the colour of cherries.

Some reports simply refer to this colour as "red" or "deep red", which may explain why some rendered images show a lighter, brighter red tone. But according to the leaker, what we will see is a purple-tinged cherry colour.

What do you think of the rumoured signature new colour for the iPhone 18 Pro? Let us know in the comments section.
